Demon Shade
Detection Radius:
700
Innate: While out of combat, Evelynn gains Demon Shade. Demon Shade: Evelynn rapidly heals while she is at low health. After level 6, Demon Shade also grants camouflage.
Innate: Evelynn shrouds herself in Demon Shade after not performing actions that break stealth for 4 seconds. Attacking or casting abilities ends Demon Shade immediately and places it on a 4-second static cooldown, reduced to 1.25 seconds from casting Last Caress. Taking damage from champions or turrets interrupts Demon Shade and places it on a 1.5-second static cooldown.
Demon Shade: While below 250 – 590 (based on level) (+ 250% AP) health, Evelynn heals herself for 15 – 150 (based on level) every second. From level 6 onward, Demon Shade also grants camouflage.
"It's better in the dark."
Notes/General Details
Targeting input
Passive
Affects
Self
NOTICE TO API USERS:Damage classifications are being amended across the League of Legends Wiki and also being refactored into the "Damage Info" tab.
Demon Shade is also placed on a 1.5 second cooldown upon respawning.
Demon Shade's cooldown incurs upon starting the attack windup of the basic attack and upon the cast time of the ability.
Demon Shade activates even if Evelynn is Recalling.
Upon Evelynn's transition into the stealth, Demon Shade will interrupt her in-progress cast commands for unit-targeted spells, excluding Whiplash and its empowered cast.
If Evelynn's last issued order was to cast Whiplash, her transition into the stealth will be followed by an automatic command for casting the ability (if no other orders were issued in the meantime).
Whenever Demon Shade activates, a puff of purple smoke will briefly appear around her.
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.

Allure
COST:
60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 Mana
COOLDOWN:
15 / 14 / 13 / 12 / 11
CAST TIME:
0.25
TARGET RANGE:
1200 / 1300 / 1400 / 1500 / 1600
Active: Evelynn curses the target enemy, causing her next basic attack or ability against the target to expunge the curse, slowing the target and refunding the mana cost. If the curse matures long enough, the expunge will increase the slow, charm the target, and apply an additional effect based on the target type.
Champions have reduced magic resist for a few seconds.
Monsters are dealt bonus magic damage and increased charm duration.
Active: Evelynn marks the target enemy champion or medium or large monster with a curse for 5 seconds.
Evelynn's next basic attack or ability hit against the target consumes the mark, slowing them by 45% for 0.75 seconds and refunding Allure's mana cost. If the target was marked for at least 2.5 seconds, the consumption is empowered.
Empowered Bonus: The target is charmed for a few seconds and the slow duration is increased to the same period. Additional effects are also applied based on the target type:
Against champions, inflicts a magic resistance reduction for 4 seconds.
Against monsters, the triggering effect deals bonus magic damage and the duration of the charm is increased by 2.25 seconds.
Charm Duration:1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 / 2.25 seconds
Magic Resistance Reduction:35 / 37.5 / 40 / 42.5 / 45%
Bonus Magic Damage:250 / 300 / 350 / 400 / 450 (+ 60% AP)
Monster Charm Duration:3.5 / 3.75 / 4 / 4.25 / 4.5 seconds
Casting Allure does not break Demon Shade nor its fade into it.
"Go on, touch me."

The mark fully forming signifies the 2.5 seconds have elapsed, meaning the charm will be applied on the triggering attack or ability.
An enemy champion cursed by Allure is alarmed of her presence and after the mark has fully formed, an arrow will appear next to them pointing towards Evelynn's direction. This is visible to both teams.
The magic resistance reduction will be applied to the attack or ability that triggers it.
Allure's mark application on a target cannot be blocked by spell shield.
The mark's consumption will not occur if the ability is blocked by a spell shield, causing the mark to remain on the target.
The magic resistance reduction debuff is applied independently of the Charm debuff when the matured mark is expunged, meaning a target can still have their magic resistance reduced while they are resisting applications of CC debuffs (e.g. Morgana's Black Shield).
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but still go on cooldown and pay its cost.(bug)
Allure will restart its cooldown whenever the mark debuff is removed.(bug)

30.04.2009
Within the dark seams of Runeterra, the demon Evelynn searches for her next victim. She lures in prey with the voluptuous façade of a human female, but once a person succumbs to her charms, Evelynn’s true form is unleashed. She then subjects her victim to unspeakable torment, gratifying herself with their pain. To the demon, these liaisons are innocent flings. To the rest of Runeterra, they are ghoulish tales of lust gone awry and horrific reminders of the cost of wanton desire.
Mara Junot
